label: ice cream in a tub.
why: Soft ice cream pours from a nozzle and folds into a heap inside a round carton, filling most of the frame; the mound grows and turns over as it fills. The interval starts after the dissolve from the cherry pour (about 14.25 to 15.25 s) and ends before the cut at 19.25 s. No ice cream cone appears in the clip, so the doodle's scoop stands for the mound and its cone for the carton.
